description: Wano wefunire model esengekeddwa okutandika okunyumya, oba genda mu Hub okufuna endala.

checkSearchInvalidVector: Omuze gw'okuyingiza gwazzaayo ekivaamu ekitakozesebwa, kale okunoonya fayiro kuyinza obutazza kintu kyonna

welcomeTitle: Novera yeetaaga okuteekawo ku nkola yo
welcomeBody: Kino kitwala eddakiika ntono: Novera ewanula yingini yaayo ey’okuteebereza n’akafaananyi akatono ak’okunoonya fayiro. Osobola okusigala ng’okozesa kompyuta yo ng’ekola.
setupDoneBody: Novera egenda kuddukanya mmotoka za wano nga zirina llama.cpp.
dsparkDescription: Ewanula omubeezi wa DSpark Q8_0 ({{size}}) ku LFM2.5-2.6B. Kiyinza okwanguya omulembe, naye kikozesa RAM oba VRAM ey’enjawulo, ne kireka memory ntono ku context. Kigezese ku hardware yo; tereeza obuwanvu bw'embeera oba okulemesa okukyusakyusa okuteebereza mu nsengeka z'ekyokulabirako.
